- done is overs rounded down times 6 plus the result of overs minus overs rounded down times 10 rounded.
- left is the larger of 0 and 120 minus done.
- need is the larger of 0 and target minus runs.
- rrr is need times 6 divided by left when left is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- crr is runs times 6 divided by done when done is more than 0, otherwise 0.
